symbols.reasoning: Rejects overlapping search and whitespace query, then clears prior customer/addresses and calls trimmed current phone. Marks searched; 404 treated ordinary notfound, other failed/null responses show error. On success assigns customer and recent-first addresses, finally clears busy and notifies NotFound. Does not compare captured phone with edited PhoneQuery after await, so query text can differ from displayed result if editable during search; read-only impact here differs from checkout customer mutation race UI007.
